We need to count aromatic carbons in the molecule. But we have no SMILES given. Possibly the sample is implicit? The system may have a sample at hand (the "sample at hand") but we don't know its structure. We need to retrieve something? Maybe we need to get the carbon NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons? But easier: maybe there is a default molecule? The task is part of a series; maybe earlier subtask gave structure. But we only have this subtask.

We could request carbon NMR spectra, then analyze peaks to count aromatic carbons. But we need to interpret peaks manually? The carbon NMR spectra will list chemical shifts; aromatic carbons typically 110-160 ppm. Count distinct aromatic carbon signals. Could be overlapping.

Better: maybe we can request the HSQC to map protons to carbons, but that's more work.

We need to minimize cost. Probably just get carbon NMR spectra.

Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
